title: Repairing Locally Misspecified GMM: An Empirical Bayes Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.23925v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Econometric models offer parsimonious but inexact approximations to data-generating processes. This paper studies the generalized method of moments (GMM) when exchangeable specification errors of order $n^{-1/2}$ contaminate the moment conditions. I develop estimators for the mean and variance of these specification errors, establishing their consistency in an asymptotic framework where the number of overidentifying restrictions grows with the sample size. These hyperparameter estimates are used to develop a feasible bias-corrected estimator of target parameters. I also propose an empirical Bayes estimator that weakly improves precision by subtracting a best linear predictor of the first-order estimation error from the bias-corrected estimator. Using a combinatorial central limit theorem, I establish asymptotic normality of both estimators and provide variance estimators that enable misspecification-aware frequentist inference. Simulatio

translated_title: 修复局部误设定的广义矩方法：一种经验贝叶斯方法
translated_abstract: 经济计量模型对数据生成过程提供了简洁但不够精确的近似。本文研究了当可交换的规范误差（阶为$n^{-1/2}$）污染矩条件时的广义矩方法（GMM）。我开发了这些规范误差的均值和方差的估计量，并在过度识别约束数量随样本量增长的渐近框架下建立了它们的一致性。这些超参数估计被用于开发目标参数的可行偏差校正估计量。我还提出了一种经验贝叶斯估计量，通过从偏差校正估计量中减去一阶估计误差的最佳线性预测器来弱化提高精度。利用组合中心极限定理，我建立了这两个估计量的渐近正态性，并提供了方差估计量，从而实现考虑误设定的频率推断。模拟...
tldr: 本文提出了一种经验贝叶斯方法，通过估计矩条件中的规范误差并修正偏差，在过度识别约束数量随样本量增长时，提高了广义矩方法估计的精度和推断的稳健性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an empirical Bayes approach that estimates specification errors in moment conditions and corrects bias, improving precision and robustness of GMM estimation when the number of overidentifying restrictions grows with sample size.
